newsitem.title: USA: Logicon postpones July 17 special meeting.
newsitem.headline: Logicon postpones July 17 special meeting.

text.p: Logicon Inc said Monday it has decided to postpone its July 17 special shareholders meeting to vote on its merger with Northrop Grumman Corp.

It said this step was taken because it was advised that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has requested that it include in its proxy statement/prospectus financial data about Northrop's proposed merger with Lockheed Martin Corp. It said it the meeting will be postponed until the proxy statement/prospectus has been supplemented with the data and recirculated.
Logicon said it will announce the new meeting date as soon as it has been determined.
